study: R9M F50 complementary panels and fixed cross-panel family stacks
status: Frozen proposal awaiting parent CPU review and launch approval

catboost.selection: Verified I strongest standalone same h1 policy by full-pool mean of all3seeds/all3folds; chosen by parent before R9L fits. New shorter600-tree fit, not an exact replay of I1200-tree fit checkpoint600.

architecture_contract.fixed_three_seed_mode: Equally average each stochastic family average-tied percentile ranks across all3 seeds, rerank family-average vectors, then apply same fixed recipe; deterministic Ridge shared.
architecture_contract.rank_arithmetic: doubled integer average ranks times integer weights summing12, divided by24*nquery; never re-average final already-tied scores

labels.source: Exact frozen H s2008_gap1_all_h1 arrays; observed ordinal1, every season_end<=outer_year-1, earlier cohorts, no unknown-to-zero
labels.transform: Frozen clipped40 cohort Gaussian target; CPU replay only, no selector/reordering
labels.query_population: Original H query PID set/order, all rows retained; scorer alone handles full and complete-target mask

reference_gate.reuse_provenance: Root separately pins and verifies six original L raw records, completed-log record hashes and task-map, complete/source freeze plus all per-job input/label/query/order/model/runtime hashes; original records remain unchanged. New M metadata is stored beside them, not inside source records.
reference_gate.mismatch_policy: Fail closed; no tolerance and no score-dependent retry.

selection: Pre2019 development-only full-query mean over all three folds and three seeds. Compare same recipes against base44 and add_f50; report every fold/seed mean. Cross-panel grid is prespecified search, not an unbiased validation estimate or learned stack.
limitations: Retrospective feature vintage, incomplete original population, source identity/coverage caveats remain. Scoped diagnostic admission only.
Changing family width changes model preprocessing/ensemble permutations; real-family versus44 difference is not a matched-shuffle information test.
No2019+ inputs, outcomes or scores; no learned weights or outer-query truth in worker.
Cross-panel view and weight search reuse the same development folds; final best recipe is a search diagnostic, not a certified goal result.

cross_panel_stacks.deduplication: Exact positive-weight family/panel/weight tuples before fitting; zero-weight absent member views do not create new recipes. No prediction/outcome-based deduplication.
cross_panel_stacks.tie_policy: Validate equality in groups defined by the union of actual participating panel predictor vectors; never re-average already tied final scores.
cross_panel_stacks.reporting: Same-seed nine fold/seed scores primary, fixed-three-seed family rank averaging separately; standalone endpoints distinct from multi-family stacks. Full-query metric primary and frozen observed mask secondary; no model promotion.
